summary: The terminal UI's Now view is now Inbox: Ctrl+H and open in Inbox focus a regular tab beside agent tabs, instead of opening a modal. Switch, close, move or split it like other tabs; Esc no longer closes it.

replay.detail: Client presentation only; no claim replay changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Attention APIs and existing list:home pane keys are unchanged. Inbox uses the existing workspace tab representation. iOS and web naming are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No expected interruption or startup work.

manual.detail: No configuration changes or re-pairing required.

recovery.detail: Inbox layouts use existing workspace persistence; no recovery changes.
